an10.238:1.1: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an10.238:1.3: Aniccasaññā anattasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aṭṭhikasaññā puḷuvakasaññā vinīlakasaññā vipubbakasaññā vicchiddakasaññā uddhūmātakasaññā.
an10.238:1.4: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā ti. 1.
